desc_zh: 认证高校的本科生和研究生，用 .edu 邮箱申请后可以领取免费语音额度，用来做课件配音、课程项目和黑客松。只限教育和非商业用途。支持约 83 种语言，也可以用大约 10 秒录音做声音克隆。额度数量以审核结果为准。
desc_en: Undergraduate and graduate students at accredited universities can apply using a .edu email address to receive a free voice quota for creating course audio, project work, and hackathons. Limited to educational and non-commercial use only. Supports approximately 83 languages, and you can also use a roughly 10-second recording for voice cloning. The quota amount is subject to approval results.
claim_zh:
1. 用.edu 邮箱点击本页的「前往官网领取」申请学生额度。
2. 等审核。通过后再用于课程、演示或比赛，不要拿去商用。
claim_en:
1. Use a .edu email address to click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page to apply for the student quota.
2. Wait for approval. Use it for courses, presentations, or competitions after approval—do not use it for commercial purposes.

name_zh: OpenASI 吉大师生免费前沿模型算力
name_en: OpenASI: Free Cutting-Edge Model Computing Power for Jilin University Students and Faculty
desc_zh: OpenASI 是面向吉林大学师生的非营利开放平台，由吉大学生初创企业 BitMiracle AI Lab 全资赞助，免费提供限量的前沿模型算力。注册需要 @mails.jlu.edu.cn 或 @jlu.edu.cn 邮箱，以及邀请码。
desc_en: OpenASI is a non-profit open platform for students and faculty at Jilin University, fully sponsored by BitMiracle AI Lab, a startup founded by Jilin University students. It provides a limited amount of free computing power for cutting-edge models. Registration requires an email address from @mails.jlu.edu.cn or @jlu.edu.cn, as well as an invitation code.
claim_zh:
1. 打开注册页，用 @mails.jlu.edu.cn 或 @jlu.edu.cn 邮箱创建账号。
2. 填写邀请码。还没有邀请码时，加入 QQ 群 1007610343 获取。
3. 登录后在额度内使用前沿模型。名额和额度有限，以平台当时说明为准。
claim_en:
1. Open the registration page and create an account using an email from @mails.jlu.edu.cn or @jlu.edu.cn.
2. Enter your invitation code. If you don't have one yet, join the QQ group 1007610343 to obtain one.
3. After logging in, use the cutting-edge models within your allocated quota. The number of spots and available quota are limited, subject to the platform's current terms.

desc_zh: Perplexity 是带引用来源的 AI 搜索。限时五折升级 Pro：年付约 $9/月，含深度研究、顶级模型切换、更高用量与记忆、文档/应用生成，以及扩展 Computer 权限。新订阅另送约 US$40 Computer 额度（4000 bonus credits）。原「学生一年免费」已不适用，请以升级页现价为准。
desc_en: Perplexity is an AI search engine with cited sources. Limited-time 50% off Pro: about $9/month when billed annually. Includes deep research, top AI model selection, higher usage and memory, document/app creation, and expanded Computer access. New upgrades also get about US$40 in Computer credits (4,000 bonus credits). The old one-year student free offer no longer applies; check the upgrade page for current pricing.
claim_zh: 1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」登录后进入 Upgrade / Select your plan。2. 限时五折：年付约 $9/月，包含深度研究、可选顶级模型、更高用量与记忆、文档和应用生成，以及扩展 Computer。3. 升级可见 +US$40 free Computer credits（4000 bonus credits，限时/新订阅福利，用完后 Pro 通常不再按月赠送额度）。4. 学生/教师若仍有 Education 通道，可在账号内走身份验证，最终价格以结算页为准。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page, log in, then go to Upgrade / Select your plan.
2. Limited-time 50% off: annual billing is about $9/month and includes deep research, selectable top models, higher usage and memory, document and app generation, and expanded Computer.
3. Upon upgrading, you can see +US$40 free Computer credits (4000 bonus credits, a limited-time/new subscription benefit; after they are used up, Pro usually no longer grants monthly credits).
4. If students/teachers still have the Education channel, they can complete identity verification within their account; the final price is subject to the checkout page.

name_zh: ChatGPT 教师版 免费至 2028 年 6 月
name_en: ChatGPT for Educators: Free Until June 2028
desc_zh: 面向美国认证 K–12 学校或学区在职的教师、职员、校领导和学区管理员，学生不能申请。验证学校邮箱后，可以使用面向课堂的 ChatGPT 工作区，免费到 2028 年 6 月。帮助中心目前列出的能力包括 GPT-5.1（Instant、Auto、Reasoning-Mini）、文件上传、深度研究、语音、图像生成、自定义 GPT，以及 SSO、角色权限和分析。默认不把内容用于训练模型，并提供面向学校的隐私保护。一个工作区只能放同一个学区的人。
desc_en: Available to active teachers, staff, school leaders, and district administrators at U.S.-accredited K–12 schools or school districts. Students are not eligible. After verifying your school email, you can access the classroom-focused ChatGPT workspace for free until June 2028. The capabilities currently listed in the Help Center include GPT-5.1 (Instant, Auto, Reasoning-Mini), file uploads, deep research, voice, image generation, custom GPTs, as well as SSO, role-based permissions, and analytics. Content is not used for model training by default, and school-specific privacy protections are provided. Only individuals from the same school district can be added to a single workspace.
claim_zh:
1. 打开 [本页的](https://xn--8pvn55a0tz/)「前往官网领取」，用学校或学区邮箱开始验证。
2. 通过后选择新建本校或本学区的工作区，或加入域名下已有的工作区，并填写职务、学科和年级。
3. 管理员可以邀请同区已验证的同事，并配置 SSO 和权限。不能把其他学区的老师加进来。
4. 验证页报错时，换一个浏览器，用同一个 ChatGPT 账号重试。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and start verification using your school or district email.
2. After verification, choose to create a new workspace for your school or district, or join an existing workspace under your domain, and fill in your role, subject, and grade level.
3. Administrators can invite verified colleagues from the same district and configure SSO and permissions. Teachers from other districts cannot be added.
4. If you encounter an error on the verification page, try again using a different browser with the same ChatGPT account.

name_zh: ChatGPT 学术研究人员计划
desc_zh: OpenAI 面向高校教职人员和博士后研究人员推出的专属计划，审核通过后可免费获得 12 个月的专属 ChatGPT 工作空间。每个工作空间最多支持 5 名成员（申请人及最多 4 名同机构协作者），享有 ChatGPT Pro 级别的使用配额、最新前沿模型访问权限，并配备企业级数据隐私保护（数据默认不用于训练模型）。申请时需通过 SheerID 验证机构隶属关系、提交代表性论文及研究用途说明。
desc_en: OpenAI's exclusive program for university faculty and postdoctoral researchers. Approved applicants receive 12 months of complimentary access to a dedicated ChatGPT workspace with ChatGPT Pro-level usage, the latest frontier models, and business-grade data privacy protections (data not used for training by default). Each workspace supports up to 5 members — the applicant plus up to 4 verified collaborators from the same institution. Applicants verify institutional affiliation via SheerID and submit a qualifying paper with a brief description of intended research use.
claim_zh:
1. 访问本页的「前往官网领取」查看最新申请入口与资格要求。
2. 使用学校/机构邮箱登录 OpenAI 账号。
3. 通过 SheerID 完成学术机构隶属关系验证。
4. 提交一篇符合条件的代表性论文及研究用途简短说明。
5. 审核通过后以 $0 完成结算（需绑定有效信用卡），即可创建专属研究工作空间。
6. 工作空间建好后，可邀请最多 4 名同机构成员加入。

注意：本计划仅面向教职人员和博士后研究人员，提供 ChatGPT 访问权限（非 API 额度）。
claim_en:
1. Visit the "Get it on the official site" button on this page to view the latest application entry and eligibility requirements.
2. Sign in to your OpenAI account using your school/institution email.
3. Complete academic institution affiliation verification through SheerID.
4. Submit one eligible representative paper and a brief description of your research use.
5. After approval, complete checkout at $0 (a valid credit card is required) to create your dedicated research workspace.
6. Once the workspace is set up, you can invite up to 4 members from the same institution to join.

Note: This program is only for faculty and postdoctoral researchers and provides ChatGPT access (not API credits).

desc_zh: 美国 K-12 教师和学区可免费使用 Claude 教师功能，包括备课技能和对接各州课程标准。默认不拿内容训练模型。
desc_en: US K-12 educators and districts get free access to Claude for Teachers, including teaching skills and state-standards curricula. Training on your content is off by default.
claim_zh:
1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」。
2. 以美国 K-12 教师身份申请；学区管理员可为全校开通，含权限和 SSO。
3. 仅面向美国 K-12，不是全球高校学生计划。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page.
2. Apply as a US K-12 teacher; district administrators can enable it for the whole school, including permissions and SSO.
3. Only for US K-12, not the global higher education student program.

name_zh: Claude API 学生体验金（已结束）
desc_zh: Anthropic 曾经向学生开发者提供 $50 API 体验金。该申请通道已结束。
desc_en: Anthropic previously offered student developers a $50 API trial credit. This application channel has now ended.
claim_zh: 这个体验金已经结束。不要再按旧表单申请 $50 额度。
claim_en: This trial credit has ended. Do not apply for the $50 credit using the old form anymore.

desc_zh: 已在当地政府注册、状态正常的非营利组织，可免费获得一年 GitLab Ultimate，云端或自建都可以，最多 20 个席位。不含技术支持。每年名额先到先得，捐助额度用完就停止申请。政治或宗教导向的组织通常不能参加。和面向学校的 GitLab 教育计划不是同一项。
desc_en: Nonprofit organizations that are registered with their local government and in good standing can receive a free one-year GitLab Ultimate license, either in the cloud or self-hosted, for up to 20 seats. Technical support is not included. Annual spots are available on a first-come, first-served basis, and applications will close once the donation quota is reached. Organizations with political or religious affiliations are generally not eligible. This is separate from the GitLab Education program for schools.
claim_zh:
1. 确认组织已注册且状态正常。超过 20 个席位不要在页面申请，改发邮件到 nonprofits@gitlab.com。
2. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，由组织联系人提交。GoodStack 会核验。
3. 通过后按邮件领取许可。每年续期必须由当初在客户门户创建订阅的同一个人操作。
claim_en:
1. Confirm that your organization is registered and in good standing. If you have more than 20 seats, do not apply through this page; instead, email nonprofits@gitlab.com.
2. Click "Go to the official website to claim" on this page, and have the organization's contact person submit the application. GoodStack will verify it.
3. Once approved, receive your license via email. Annual renewals must be handled by the same person who originally created the subscription in the customer portal.

desc_zh: 个人可用学校邮箱写信并核对学生证，首次购买任意 MDB 套餐享 5 折。学校在官网发布 MDB 指定教程并通过审核后，学生还能用学校邮箱免费使用高级组件 12 个月，仅限教育用途。
desc_en: Individuals can apply by email with a school email address and verify their student ID to get 50% off their first purchase of any MDB plan. After the school publishes an MDB-designated tutorial on its official website and it passes review, students can also use advanced components free for 12 months with a school email address, for educational use only.
claim_zh:
要 5 折：用学校邮箱写信申请，按回复核对学生证。
要免费：请教师或图书馆按页面要求把教程发在学校域名上，并邮件通知 MDB，通过后用学校邮箱领取。
claim_en:
For 50% off: apply by email with your school email address, then verify your student ID according to the reply.
For free access: ask a teacher or the library to publish the tutorial on the school domain as required on the page, and email MDB to notify them; after approval, claim it with your school email address.

name_en: BrowserStack Free for Students for One Year
desc_zh: GitHub 学生开发者包包含 BrowserStack 一年免费许可，含 Live 和 Automate Mobile，可在 3000 多种桌面浏览器以及 Android、iOS 真机上做交互测试和自动化测试，价值约 $2,388/年。
desc_en: The GitHub Student Developer Pack includes a one-year free license to BrowserStack, covering Live and Automate Mobile. This allows you to perform interactive and automated testing across over 3,000 desktop browsers and real Android and iOS devices, valued at approximately $2,388/year.
claim_zh:
1. 先完成 [GitHub Education](https://education.github.com/pack) 学生认证。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，点击 Sign Up with GitHub。
3. 用已认证的 GitHub 账号授权登录，领取 Live 和 Automate Mobile 一年免费许可。
claim_en:
1. First, complete your student verification at [GitHub Education](https://education.github.com/pack).
2. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and click Sign Up with GitHub.
3. Use your verified GitHub account to authorize your login and claim your one-year free license to Live and Automate Mobile.

desc_zh: Windsurf 是专为保持编程心流状态设计的 AI 代码编辑器。使用.edu 邮箱注册即可享受 Pro 订阅超过 5 折优惠，无需额外验证。
desc_en: Windsurf is an AI code editor built to keep you in flow state. Sign up with a .edu email to get over 50% off on a Pro subscription — no extra verification needed.
claim_zh:
1. 访问本页的「前往官网领取」
2. 点击「Sign up with school email」，使用.edu 邮箱注册账号
3. 注册成功后自动获得 Pro 订阅超 50% 折扣
4. 如学校不使用.edu 邮箱，可通过页面 FAQ 联系官方申请
claim_en:
1. Visit the "Get it on the official site" button on this page
2. Click "Sign up with school email" and register an account with a .edu email
3. After successful registration, you automatically get over 50% off a Pro subscription
4. If your school does not use .edu email, contact the official team through the FAQ on the page to apply

name_zh: v0 指定院校学生免费一年 Premium
name_en: Free One-Year Premium for Students at Designated Institutions
desc_zh: Vercel 的 AI 应用生成工具。目前只对页面列出的在读院校开放。用该校学生邮箱完成验证后，可免费使用 v0 Premium 一年。名单里有斯坦福、哈佛、普林斯顿、加州大学伯克利分校、麻省理工、纽约大学、滑铁卢大学等，并会继续增加。学校不在名单里时可以加入等候名单，同校报名的人越多，越有机会被加进去。其他学生仍可使用 v0 免费版。
desc_en: Vercel's AI application generation tool. Currently available only to students at the institutions listed on the page. After verifying your identity with a student email from one of these schools, you can use v0 Premium for free for one year. The list includes Stanford, Harvard, Princeton, University of California, Berkeley, MIT, New York University, University of Waterloo, and more, with additional schools being added regularly. If your school isn't on the list, you can join the waitlist—the more students from your school who sign up, the higher the chance it will be added. Students from other schools can still use the free version of v0.
claim_zh:
1. 打开 [本页的](https://xn--8pvn55a0tz/)「前往官网领取」，查看自己的学校是否在 Active Schools 里。
2. 用该校学生邮箱注册或登录，按页面完成学生验证。
3. 验证通过后获得一年 v0 Premium。学校不在名单中就加入等候名单。
claim_en:
1. Visit the "Get it on the official site" button on this page to check if your school is listed under Active Schools.
2. Register or log in using your student email from the eligible school and complete the student verification process as instructed on the page.
3. Once verified, you'll receive one year of v0 Premium. If your school isn't on the list, join the waitlist.

desc_zh: 通过 GitHub Student Developer Pack 可免费使用 GitKraken 学生计划 6 个月（Desktop、GitLens、CLI 等）。之后仍是学生可按官方学生价续，约等于 Pro 的 2–3 折。
desc_en: Verified GitHub Student Developer Pack members get 6 months of the GitKraken Student plan free (Desktop, GitLens, CLI, and more). After that, enrolled students can keep the discounted student price — official copy says about 75–80% off Pro.
claim_zh:
1. 先加入 GitHub Student Developer Pack 并完成学生验证。
2. 用 GitHub 注册 GitKraken，或把已有账号绑到 GitHub。
3. 在 Pack 仪表盘点 GitKraken，或打开本页的「前往官网领取」领取 6 个月。
4. 到期仍是学生可续学生价；GitHub 教育资格失效后优惠可能消失。
claim_en:
1. First join the GitHub Student Developer Pack and complete student verification.
2. Sign up for GitKraken with GitHub, or link your existing account to GitHub.
3. In the Pack dashboard, click GitKraken, or open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page to claim 6 months.
4. When it expires, if you're still a student, you can renew at the student price; after your GitHub education eligibility expires, the discount may disappear.

desc_zh: 学生、教师和高校科研人员可免费使用一年 Sentry 教育账户。官方当前额度：不限成员、5 万错误、5GB 日志、500 万 spans、500 replays、1 个 cron、$20 Seer 点数/月。GitHub Student Pack 也可激活。
desc_en: Students, teachers, and university researchers can use a Sentry education account free for one year. The current offer lists unlimited members, 50K errors, 5GB logs, 5M spans, 500 replays, 1 cron monitor, and $20 in Seer credits per month. GitHub Student Developer Pack members can activate it too.
claim_zh:
1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」。
2. 持有 GitHub Student Developer Pack 时可按页面激活；教师和科研人员按教育资格申请。
3. 当前页面写明免费一年。额度以账户内实际配额为准。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page.
2. If you have the GitHub Student Developer Pack, activate it as directed on the page; teachers and researchers apply based on educational eligibility.
3. The current page states free for one year. Allowances are based on the actual quota in your account.

desc_zh: GitHub Student Developer Pack 学生可在学籍有效期内免费使用 LocalStack 的 AWS 本地模拟器，并含每月 1,000 CI/CD 额度。
desc_en: GitHub Student Developer Pack members get LocalStack's AWS emulator free while they stay in the Pack, including 1,000 CI/CD credits a month.
claim_zh:
1. 确认 GitHub Education 权益有效。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，用 GitHub 关联并开通学生计划。
3. 若进了付费试用，到 Settings → Billing 再选 Student Plan。离开 Pack 后不再符合。
claim_en:
1. Confirm your GitHub Education benefits are active.
2. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page, connect with GitHub, and activate the student plan.
3. If you entered a paid trial, go to Settings → Billing and then select Student Plan. You are no longer eligible after leaving the Pack.

desc_zh: GitHub 学生可免费使用 Pageclip Basic：不限表单数量，含 2 万次提交，适合静态网站表单。在学生资格内有效。
desc_en: GitHub students get the Pageclip Basic plan free: unlimited forms and 20,000 submissions, for static-site forms, while they remain students.
claim_zh:
1. 先通过 GitHub Student Developer Pack。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」注册领取 Basic。
3. GitHub 教育页写明学生期间免费。
claim_en:
1. First get approved for the GitHub Student Developer Pack.
2. Go to the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and sign up to claim Basic.
3. The GitHub Education page states it is free while you are a student.

name_zh: MongoDB 学生包：$50 Atlas + 免费认证
name_en: MongoDB Student Pack: $50 Atlas Credit + Free Cert
desc_zh: 通过 GitHub Student Developer Pack 领取 $50 Atlas 额度，学完对应路径还可免费考认证。需在读学历项目、可核验学生身份，年满 13 岁。
desc_en: Via the GitHub Student Developer Pack: $50 MongoDB Atlas credit, plus a free certification after completing a learning path. Must be in a degree/diploma program, verifiable student, 13+.
claim_zh:
1. 先开通 GitHub Student Developer Pack（学历项目在读、可核验学生身份、有 GitHub 账号、年满 13 岁）。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，用 GitHub 登录后点 Request your access code。
3. 把 Atlas 优惠码加到所选 Organization（每码只能用一次）。未使用约 90 天过期，建议要兑换时再生成。
4. 兑换 Atlas 额度通常需绑定信用卡或 PayPal；额度按用量扣。完成学习路径后可领免费认证券。
claim_en:
1. First activate the GitHub Student Developer Pack (enrolled in a degree program, verifiable student status, have a GitHub account, and be at least 13 years old).
2. Go to the "Get it on the official site" button on this page, sign in with GitHub, and click Request your access code.
3. Add the Atlas promo code to your chosen Organization (each code can only be used once). Unused codes expire after about 90 days, so it's recommended to generate it only when you're ready to redeem.
4. Redeeming Atlas credits usually requires linking a credit card or PayPal; credits are deducted based on usage. After completing the learning path, you can get a free certification voucher.

desc_zh: Hyperbolic 提供模型 API 和 GPU。用教育邮箱注册可获得 $15 额度，可用于模型调用和 GPU 租用。
desc_en: Hyperbolic provides model APIs and GPUs. Register with an educational email address to receive a $15 credit, which can be used for model calls and GPU rentals.
claim_zh:
1. 用教育邮箱点击本页的「前往官网领取」注册。
2. 到账 $15 后即可调用模型或租 GPU。额度用完即止，不会按月补充。
claim_en:
1. Use an educational email address to click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page and register.
2. Once the $15 credit is applied, you can start using models or renting GPUs. The credit is valid until exhausted and will not be replenished monthly.

name_zh: Wispr Flow 学生 3 个月免费 + 五折
name_en: Wispr Flow Student: 3 months free, then 50% off
desc_zh: Wispr Flow 是可在任意应用里使用的语音输入工具，支持 Mac / Windows / iPhone / Android，号称比打字快约 4 倍，支持 100+ 语言。学生用.edu 邮箱注册后自动开通：新用户先免 3 个月，之后 $6/月（五折，按年计），可随时取消。没有.edu 邮箱可提交学生证等材料，或联系客服开通。
desc_en: Wispr Flow is a voice dictation tool that works in any app on Mac, Windows, iPhone, and Android. It claims to be about 4x faster than typing and supports 100+ languages. Sign up with a .edu email to auto-activate the student offer: 3 months free for new subscribers, then $6/month (50% off, billed annually). Cancel anytime. Without a .edu email, submit student ID or contact Support.
claim_zh: 1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，点击免费开始并注册账号。2. 下载 Mac / Windows / iOS / Android 客户端。3. 用学校.edu 邮箱登录 App，学生优惠会自动生效：新订阅先免 3 个月，之后 $6/月（五折）。4. 没有.edu 邮箱可联系 Support，或提交学生证、在读证明、缴费单、学生后台截图等材料。仅限新订阅，可随时取消。教师、研究者、非营利也可申请教育折扣。价格与资格以官网为准。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page, click Start for free and register an account.
2. Download the Mac / Windows / iOS / Android client.
3. Log in to the App with your school .edu email; the student discount will be applied automatically: new subscriptions get the first 3 months free, then $6/month (50% off).
4. If you don't have a .edu email, contact Support, or submit materials such as a student ID, proof of enrollment, tuition bill, or a screenshot of the student portal. New subscriptions only, cancel anytime. Teachers, researchers, and nonprofits can also apply for the education discount. Pricing and eligibility are subject to the official website.

name_en: Youdao Cloud Note Student One-Year Plan
desc_zh: 学生认证通过后，有道云笔记 VIP 可以免费使用一年，包含高级笔记和云同步。到期后恢复普通版。
desc_en: After student verification is approved, you can use Youdao Cloud Note VIP for free for one year, including advanced note features and cloud sync. After expiration, it will revert to the standard version.
claim_zh:
1. 点击本页的「前往官网领取」，登录有道账号。
2. 完成学生认证。一年从通过那天起算，以账号里的 VIP 到期日为准。
claim_en:
1. Click "Go to Official Website to Claim" on this page and log in to your Youdao account.
2. Complete student verification. The one-year period starts from the day of approval, with the VIP expiration date in your account serving as the reference.

name_zh: 夸克开学季：学生/教师认证领网盘+扫描王 VIP
name_en: Quark Back-to-School: Free Cloud Drive & Scan VIP for Students & Teachers
desc_zh: 夸克 2026 开学季活动：大学生、教师完成教育认证可各领 3 个月夸克网盘 VIP + 3 个月扫描王 VIP（至 9 月 30 日）。教师节（9/8–9/12）教师经「夸克教育计划」支付宝小程序还可额外领扫描王年卡，最高合计 18 个月。
desc_en: Quark 2026 back-to-school: verified students and teachers get 3 months Quark Drive VIP + 3 months Scan VIP (until Sep 30). Teachers can claim an extra Scan VIP annual card via the Quark Education Alipay mini program on Sep 8–12 (up to 18 months total).
claim_zh:
1. 打开夸克 APP，进入个人中心或搜索「教育认证」，进入开学季活动页；也可访问活动链接或「夸克教育计划」支付宝小程序。
2. 选择身份：大学生（学信网学籍核验）或教师（教师资格证生效核验）。
3. 完成认证后领取 3 个月夸克网盘 VIP + 3 个月夸克扫描王 VIP（活动至 9 月 30 日，每用户限领一次）。
4. 教师节专享（9 月 8 日–12 日）：教师通过「夸克教育计划」支付宝小程序完成认证，可额外领取扫描王 VIP 年卡；叠加后最高约 18 个月会员。

注意：具体权益与截止时间以官方活动页为准。
claim_en:
1. Open the Quark app, go to the personal center or search for 'Education Verification' to enter the Back-to-School Season activity page; you can also visit the activity link or the 'Quark Education Program' Alipay Mini Program.
2. Choose identity: college student (CHSI student status verification) or teacher (teacher qualification certificate validity verification).
3. After completing verification, claim 3 months of Quark Cloud Drive VIP + 3 months of Quark Scan King VIP (activity until September 30, limited to one claim per user).
4. Teachers' Day exclusive (September 8–12): teachers who complete verification via the 'Quark Education Program' Alipay Mini Program can additionally claim a Quark Scan King VIP annual card; after stacking, up to about 18 months of membership.

Note: Specific benefits and deadlines are subject to the official activity page.

desc_zh: 学生和教师购买 Xmind 可走教育价。教育页展示 Premium 约 $3.42/月（另有划线价），需提交在读或在职证明，以结算页为准。
desc_en: Students and educators can buy Xmind at the education price. The education page shows Premium at about $3.42/month. Proof of status is required; confirm the price at checkout.
claim_zh:
1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」选择教育方案。
2. 提交学生证、在读证明、课表、教师工作证明或.edu 邮箱等材料。
3. 审核通过后再付款。提供虚假材料会被取消资格。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and choose an education plan.
2. Submit materials such as a student ID, proof of enrollment, class schedule, teacher employment proof, or .edu email.
3. Pay after approval. Submitting false materials will result in disqualification.

desc_zh: Loom 的教育页介绍用录屏做讲解、作业说明和答疑。该页没有单独的免费教育许可或学生折扣。
desc_en: Loom's education page shows how to use screen recordings for lessons, assignments, and answers. It does not list a separate free education license or student discount.
claim_zh: 打开本页的「前往官网领取」了解教学用法。页面未提供师生免费方案，账户类型以 Loom 定价页为准。
claim_en: Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page to learn about teaching uses. The page does not provide a free plan for teachers and students; refer to Loom's pricing page for account types.

desc_zh: 学生可免费使用一年 Lumion Student，功能对齐 Lumion Pro 2026，渲染带小水印，在读可续。教师许可 3 年，仅限学校机房，不能商用。
desc_en: Students get Lumion Student free for one year, with Lumion Pro 2026 features and a small watermark, renewable while enrolled. Faculty licenses last 3 years, for campus labs only, and are not for commercial use.
claim_zh:
1. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」，按学生或教师申请。
2. 学生许可 1 年，在读可续。作品不能用商业版打开，也不能商用。
3. 教师版只用于大学机房。先看系统要求。
claim_en:
1. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page and apply as a student or teacher.
2. Student license is valid for 1 year, renewable while enrolled. Projects cannot be opened with the commercial version and cannot be used commercially.
3. Teacher version is only for university computer labs. Check system requirements first.

name_zh: Scrimba Pro 学生 1 个月
desc_zh: GitHub Student Developer Pack 学生可免费使用 1 个月 Scrimba Pro，含全部课程、项目和编程挑战。
desc_en: GitHub Student Developer Pack members get 1 month of Scrimba Pro free, including all courses, projects, and coding challenges.
claim_zh:
1. 先加入 GitHub Student Developer Pack。
2. 打开本页的「前往官网领取」领取 1 个月 Pro。
3. 到期后是否续费以 Scrimba 账户为准。
claim_en:
1. First join the GitHub Student Developer Pack.
2. Open the "Get it on the official site" button on this page to claim 1 month of Pro.
3. Whether you renew after expiration depends on your Scrimba account.
